skill.name: skill-marketplace-publisher
skill.description: Publish Codex, Claude, or Claude Code skills to public marketplaces with audit, packaging, GitHub publication, and submission steps.
skill.summary: Prepare public-safe AI skills and submit them to marketplace intake routes.
skill.author: Sliense-ysd

security_audit.summary: Most high static secret detections are scanner regex definitions rather than embedded credentials. Real risks remain around .env scanning, redaction gaps, outbound marketplace submissions, sibling-directory command execution, and public repository publication.

remediation.issue: Audit output can reveal matched secret values.
remediation.suggestion: Redact secrets before storing or printing Finding.text; show only kind, file, line, and masked evidence.

remediation.issue: Workflow executes scripts through sibling-directory relative paths.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve trusted tool paths explicitly, verify ownership, or package required validators with the skill.

remediation.issue: Submission script sends user data to external endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Preview the exact payload and require explicit confirmation before each network submission.

remediation.issue: Public GitHub publication can expose unintended files.
remediation.suggestion: Generate a dry-run manifest and require review before copying, committing, pushing, or submitting artifacts.

content.value_statement: Publishing a skill safely requires audit, packaging, repository setup, and marketplace-specific submission steps. This skill gives Codex, Claude, and Claude Code users a repeatable public release workflow.
actual_capabilities: Runs a local public-safety audit script over a skill tree.
Checks required skill metadata and referenced support files.
Defines a clean public GitHub repository publication flow.
Submits repository URLs to Skillstore and SkillMap feedback endpoints.
limitations: Marketplace routes may change and need fresh verification.
Local packaging and validation scripts must already exist.
Marketplace acceptance is not guaranteed after submission.
Audit output must be redacted to avoid exposing matched secrets.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skillstore Submission
use_cases.description: Audit a local skill, publish a clean GitHub repository, and submit the repository URL to Skillstore.

use_cases.title: Request a SkillMap Listing
use_cases.description: Create a listing request with repository details, summary text, and contact information for SkillMap review.

use_cases.title: Package Private Work for Public Release
use_cases.description: Decide when to publish source directly and when to create a sanitized public package first.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this local skill for public release. Tell me whether it is safe to package or publish.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Marketplace Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare this skill for a public marketplace. Use public packaging if the source folder is not portable.

prompt_templates.title: Submit to Skillstore
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish this skill to a public GitHub repository and submit the repository URL to Skillstore.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multi-Marketplace Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit, package, publish, and submit this skill to each verified marketplace. Record IDs, URLs, and follow-up items.

output_examples.input: A developer asks to prepare a skill for Skillstore.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports audit status, packaging choice, public repository URL, and the Skillstore submission status.

output_examples.input: A maintainer asks whether SkillMap is supported.
output_examples.output: The assistant explains that feedback or contact intake is verified, while self-service listing is unverified.

output_examples.input: A team requests public packaging for a private skill.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends a public package, lists sanitization checks, and records follow-up items before publication.

best_practices: Run the public-safety audit before copying files into a public repository.
Use public packaging when a skill references private paths, secrets, or local-only assumptions.
Record submission IDs, status URLs, timestamps, and manual follow-up items.
anti_patterns: Do not publish a source folder that still contains secrets or private business logic.
Do not claim a marketplace is supported without a verified public intake route.
Do not submit to external endpoints before reviewing the payload and destination.

faq.question: Which tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Codex, Claude, and Claude Code workflows that use public GitHub repositories for marketplace submission.

faq.question: Does it create marketplace listings automatically?
faq.answer: It can submit to supported intake endpoints, but marketplace approval and publication remain external review decisions.

faq.question: When should I use public packaging?
faq.answer: Use public packaging when the source skill may contain private paths, secrets, or non-portable runtime assumptions.

faq.question: Does it verify current marketplace rules?
faq.answer: It includes dated marketplace notes. Recheck routes before making claims about current marketplace support.

faq.question: Can it publish to SkillMap?
faq.answer: It sends a feedback listing request because no self-service SkillMap listing form was verified in the skill notes.

faq.question: What should I review before submission?
faq.answer: Review audit results, package contents, repository visibility, outbound payloads, and any manual follow-up requirements.
